project.title: MES Acceptance I - Fatal failure and MES fallback
project.description:
Create an 8 second narrated documentary montage at EXACTLY 24 fps using only real open motion footage from NASA and/or Wikimedia Commons. Use the supplied narration, trimmed to the 8 second timeline. Music is explicitly opted out, so the mix is narration only. Honour the supplied locked timeline: 24 fps and the two locked scene boundaries.

This run is deliberately interrupted more times than the configured retry limit allows, so the OpenMontage attempt is expected to end in a classified fatal failure. Checkpoint whatever completes; never delete prior work. No fault-injection code exists in the runner - the failure is produced purely by killing the real runner process tree.
